items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Ross Russell got us together to record with Charlie Parker... I used to pick Wardell up... we recorded just about every other day for Ross Russell and Dial Records.

ctx.x: So now it comes out! [LAUGHS] Erroll had ears like you wouldn't believe. So after I had played it, he sat down and started playing it.

So Ross Russell got us together to record with Charlie Parker and Wardell Gray and Dexter Gordon and Howard McGhee and...let's see, maybe some other people, but those are the ones that come to mind. So after we had finished with Charlie Parker one day, Ross said, "Do a couple of things." So we did "Pastels," and after that we played another thing which we had made up called "Trio."
